transcript: Here are three things you should take every morning for your gut and liver health. My friend, the way you begin your morning decides how your organs will carry you through the day. In Chinese medicine, the liver governs the smooth flow of energy, and the gut is where nourishment becomes vitality. First, berries, blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, blackberries. Dark foods nourish the liver and blood, cool internal heat, and protect the body from early aging. Fresh when possible, freeze dried when needed. Second, a small handful of mixed nuts, walnuts, almonds, pistachios, pecans, cashews. They support kidney essence, strengthen the brain, and provide steady energy when eaten in balance. Third, hot water. Simple, warm, intentional. Hot water wakes the digestive system, supports the spleen and stomach, and helps the liver release stagnation from the night. Healing does not come from extremes, it comes from daily rhythm. If you want deeper guidance, I've placed my e-books in the link on my profile. Simple teachings you can return to each day. Save this and walk gently with your body.
